setup.title: Setup
setup.help: Create a new organization. This will be used to manage your projects and teams.
setup.organizationDescription: Organizations are used to manage your projects and teams.
setup.projectDescription: Projects are used to group traces, datasets, evals and prompts. Environments can be separated using the built-in environment feature.

organizationForm.name: Organization name
organizationForm.cloudAiDescription: Relevant project data can be sent to AWS Bedrock within your Langfuse data region. Your data will not be used for training models.
organizationForm.selfHostedAiDescription: Relevant project data can be sent to the model provider configured by your instance administrator.

overview.title: Organizations
overview.help: Organizations help you manage access to projects. Each organization can have multiple projects and team members with different roles.
overview.emptyProjects: This organization has no projects yet.
overview.demoDescription: We have built a Q&A chatbot that answers questions based on the Langfuse Docs. Interact with it to see traces in Langfuse.
overview.createOrganizationToStart: Create an organization to get started. Alternatively, ask your organization admin to invite you.
overview.invitationRequired: You need to get invited to an organization to get started with Langfuse.

dangerActions.confirmInstruction: To confirm, type "{value}" in the input box
dangerActions.deleteOrganizationBlocked: You can only delete an organization if it has no projects associated with it. Please delete or transfer all projects first. Deleting projects may take a few minutes.
dangerActions.deleteOrganizationPermission: You don't have permission to delete this organization.
dangerActions.organizationDeletedDescription: The organization has been successfully deleted.
dangerActions.deleteProjectPermission: You don't have permission to delete this project.
dangerActions.transferWarningIntro: Transferring the project will move it to a different organization:
dangerActions.transferWarningAccess: Members who are not part of the new organization will lose access.
dangerActions.transferWarningOperation: The project remains fully operational as API keys, settings, and data will remain unchanged. All features (e.g. tracing, prompt management) will continue to work without interruption.
dangerActions.transferDescription: Transfer this project to another organization where you have the ability to create projects.

dangerActions.projectTransferredDescription: The project is successfully transferred to the new organization. Redirecting...
